title: Will the New Orleans style survive?
summary: Perhonas asks if Russell sees himself as preserving the style, and Russell is discouraged by how few Johnny Dodds records are in print.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Do you see... This is kind of a broad question, but... Uh... Do you see yourself at all in... As a long-time collector and writer, et cetera, and also your role at the archives and... Um...
